title: The landing moves to the portal, the rail gains its first row, and every wait that asserted the old destination
allCallSites: apps/web/app/login/LoginForm.tsx#landingFor — returns 'members' for every staff principal today (line 76) and 'requests' for a client contact (line 68); the staff answer becomes the organization root and `destination` must not leave a trailing slash
apps/web/app/login/LoginForm.tsx#destination — honours ?next only when it startsWith `/org/{organizationId}/`, which TC-01-E2E-01's second leg relies on and which is unchanged

e2e/tests/signup.spec.ts:16 — NOT a sign-in. The signup form pushes /org/{id}/members itself (apps/web/app/signup/SignupForm.tsx:101) and REQ-01-001 moves the post-sign-in destination only, so this wait stays exactly as it is

e2e/tests/client-participants.spec.ts:32 — signInUi waits `**/${destination}` and is called with 'members' at lines 180, 227, 282, 341, 391 and 565. **A literal-string grep does not find it**, and the six staff sign-ins there break silently when the landing moves
e2e/tests/invitation.spec.ts:115 — waits /org/{id}/members after accepting an invitation. AcceptInviteScreen.tsx:314 owns that destination and this spec does not move it; the wait stays
e2e/tests/member-detail.spec.ts:93 and :115 — a click through to a member card, not a landing; unchanged
detail: REQ-01-001: `landingFor` answers the organization root for a staff principal and keeps 'requests' for a client contact (REQ-01-002, which needs no new code — the branch at LoginForm.tsx:65-70 already does it, and client-participants.spec.ts:206/253/337/510 already observes it). REQ-01-003: `navigation()` in apps/web/src/layout/Sidebar.tsx unshifts a { type: 'link', title: 'Team overview', Icon: OrgIcon, href: at(''), testId: 'nav-portal' } as the first item, **after** the client-principal early return at line 81-83 so a contact never gets it — a destination the org layout already answers them 404 for (apps/web/app/org/[orgId]/layout.tsx:90-93) would be a dead link. 'Team overview' is the design system's own label for this row (packages/ds/src/components/navigation/Sidebar.tsx:120). No capability gate: every staff role holds ViewPortalHome. Then the waits: 33 literal `waitForURL('**/members')` lines across 28 files plus the six parameterised staff calls in client-participants.spec.ts, minus signup.spec.ts:16 and invitation.spec.ts:115, which are not sign-ins. authentication.spec.ts:23 and :86 assert the landing as behaviour rather than as scaffolding; amend the assertion, do not delete the case. A wait that genuinely means to be on the members list navigates there.
